liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **She Belongs To Me** (1 review): Garcia's cracking voice conveys emotional fragility in the second reading of the lyrics [37]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-04-07.132713.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 142 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1985-04-07.118484.sbd.healy.damico.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 140 min; rated 3.36/5 by 11 [2]. Said about its sound: Clear soundboard recording includes Matrix sound at appropriate moments; One channel is phase-inverted, producing a strange sound until corrected in DAW [32][39]
- **gd1985-04-07.169904.matrix.miksis.sacks.hunt.mattes.clugston.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 140 min [3]
- **gd1985-04-07.169900.sbd.patched.pitched.remaster.sacks.keith.miksis.flac1648**: soundboard; 18 songs; 140 min [4]
- **gd1985-04-07.139542.5-1.tobin.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 141 min [5]
- **gd1985-04-07.senn-hubbard.bandrofcheck.81454.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 139 min; rated 2/5 by 1 [14]. Said about its sound: This specific recording is flat by an entire semitone [38]
- **gd1985-04-07.senn421.cohen.103429.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 132 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [28]. Said about its sound: Best available audience recording; muddy low end but well-blended vocals and even EQ [35]

## Around the show

- Phil mocked Bobby's early 70s greeting, launching the crowd into excitement [32]
- Reviewer recalls intense energy from this three-show run as a high school senior [33]
- Stunning performance after the band resuscitated the song following a 19-year absence [41]
- Reviewer prefers the final night of the run over this Philadelphia show [42]

facts.lineage: The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment and Dolby B decoding on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions).
facts.source: Just to the right of the Board Sennheisser 421s>Sony TCD5M>Sony WMD6 Maxell XLII cassette masters. Dolby B was used on the Master Cassettes.
